PROFILE SUMMARY 
Dynamic and outcome-driven Delivery Manager with 12+ years of experience leading enterprise 
payment platforms, banking technology integrations, and large-scale multi-country rollouts. 
Specialized in card payment processing, issuer/acquirer systems, POS & eCommerce integrations, PCI-
DSS compliance, EMV, tokenization, and ISO 8583 banking protocols. 
Currently driving delivery excellence at AurusTech, overseeing multi-million-dollar payment programs for 
Fortune 500 retailers and financial institutions. Adept at managing cross-functional engineering squads, 
vendor ecosystems, regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, and enterprise program governance. 
Proven track record in delivering bank-grade, highly available, secure transaction systems aligned with 
the standards of leading banks such as JPMC, Citi, HSBC, Barclays, and Deutsche Bank.
